responsibility: Declares reusable support types for builtin Rust derive expansion of comparison traits. It defines SelfOther, which packages corresponding expressions from self and other and provides helpers to enumerate struct fields or tuple indexes, and EnumMatchBuilder, which exposes the common interface for building enum-variant MatchCase destructuring patterns and delegated result expressions used by derive implementations that compare two values variant-by-variant.
same_name_distinction: Provides the interface and support types for shared comparison-derive helpers, whereas rust-derive-cmp-common.cc supplies their implementations for pairing self/other member expressions and constructing enum-variant match cases.
